title: Sunkcost shared definitions v1
description: Definitions referenced by the other v1 schemas. Not a document type itself, so it has no schema_version property.

uuid_v7.description: Lower-case canonical UUIDv7 (RFC 9562): version nibble 7, variant 10xx.

timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp with a literal Z and 0-9 fractional digits. Digits beyond microseconds are truncated when parsed.

money.description: Non-negative USD amount as a decimal string with at most 9 fractional digits; stored as numeric(20,9). Never a JSON number.

f64.description: An IEEE-754 float64 written as a decimal string, e.g. Python repr(float). Must be finite. Never a JSON number.

f64_nonneg.description: Like f64 but without a sign.

open_unit_4dp.description: Decimal strictly between 0 and 1 with 1-4 fractional digits, e.g. "0.95". Used for target_recall and delta.

rate_4dp.description: Decimal in [0, 1] with at most 4 fractional digits, e.g. "0.05". rate x 10000 is therefore an integer.

text.description: Free-form identifier text, 1-256 characters, no NUL.

workload_name.description: Workload name, unique per project, e.g. support.billing_dispute.

external_ref.description: Caller's reference for the run (ticket ID, CI job ID). Used to attach late outcomes.

outcome_source.description: Who reported an outcome, e.g. sdk, zendesk.
